follow-up time: Until thrombus resolution or loss to follow-up
exposure: Continuous low-flow infusion of diluted heparin saline
cohort: 31 women with pernicious placenta previa (PPP) who underwent prophylactic balloon occlusion of the abdominal aorta (PBOAA) during cesarean section.
finding: Continuous low-flow infusion of diluted heparin saline during PBOAA effectively reduced the incidence of thrombosis without increasing intraoperative blood loss in women with PPP.
